contexts.text: The Levites numbered from 30 to 50 years. Explained.
The Levites taken for the ministry at 30. Explained. AC 5335:2. AC 5335:3.
The Levites given to Aaron. Explained.

Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? () = the doctrine of good and truth... Aaron is called the Levite, because by a Levite is signified the doctrine of good and truth of the Church, which ministers and is of service to the priesthood.

The Levites were accepted in place of the firstborn, because by Levi was represented the good of faith, or charity, (). That the good of faith is that which is to be ascribed to the Lord... AC 8080:4.
The priests the Levites () = those who are in truths from good.
The priesthood which is represented by the Levites, is the Lord's work of salvation proceeding from this again. (See Aaron.)
The work of the salvation of those who are thence in natural good, is represented by the priesthood of the Levites... and therefore it is said concerning the Levites that they were given to Aaron ().

The Levites represented truths ministering to good; and Aaron, the good to which they ministered; and therefore the Levites were agitated (); that is, vivified. Therefore, also, it is said that they are to be purified, Explained.
As the Levites represented the Divine truths in Heaven and in the Church being of service to Divine good, they were given to Aaron in place of all the firstborn...

The Levites () = those who are in worship (from the good of love and of charity, and from the truths of faith)... The Levites the priests, My ministers () = those who are in the good of love to the Lord, and in the derivative worship... Thus will I multiply... the Levites My ministers () = the fructification of Divine good with those who have conjunction with the Lord. Here, as elsewhere, by the Levites, the priests, are signified those who are in the good of love and of charity; and, in the abstract sense, this good. AE 527:5.
This opposite is signified by the Levite, in the parable... ()... The Levite = those who have no charity towards the neighbour, such as there were in Jerusalem at that time.

The Levites were received in place of all the first-born, because by Levi, and thence by a Levite, is signified spiritual good from celestial good; and therefore the priesthood, by which is signified celestial good, was given to Aaron and his sons; and the ministry of this good, by which is signified truth from good, was given to the Levites.

The reason the works and ministries of the Levites... are called warfare, is that the Levites represented the truths of the Church; and Aaron, to whom the Levites were given... for service, represented the Lord as to the good of love, and as to the work of salvation; and as the Lord... regenerates and saves men by means of truths from the Word, and also [by their means] removes the evils and falsities which are from Hell, continually fighting against them, therefore the offices and ministries of the Levites were called warfare...
